CHAPTER.VERS: And this know you, that in the last days there shall come perilous times,

for men
people shall be lovers of themselves, lovers of money, boasters, proud, evil-speakers
profane, those speaking insults , to parents disobedient, unthankful, unkind
unsacred (Gk. anosios) ,

without natural affection
affectionless , implacable
unappeasable, irreconcilable, relentless , false accusers
slanderers , incontinent
without restraint, undisciplined, lacking self-control , fierce, not lovers of those who are good,

traitors, heady
rash, reckless , lofty
conceited , lovers of pleasure
hedonists more
rather than lovers of God,

having a form
semblance of piety, and its power having denied; and from these be turning away,

for of these there are those coming into the houses and leading captive the silly women, laden
weighed down, heaped, piled with sins, led away with desires manifold
of various sorts ,

always learning, and
yet never to a knowledge of truth able to come,

and, even as Jannes and Jambres stood against
opposed Moses, so also these do stand against
oppose the truth, men
people corrupted in mind, disapproved
rejected concerning the faith;

but they shall not advance any further, for their folly shall be manifest
obvious, plain to all, as theirs also did become.

And you -- you have followed after my teaching, manner of life, purpose, faith, long-suffering
patience, forbearance , love, endurance,
the persecutions, the afflictions, that befell me in Antioch, in Iconium, in Lystra; what persecutions I endured, and out of all the Lord did deliver me,
and all also who will to live piously in Christ Jesus shall be persecuted,

and evil men
people and impostors shall advance to the worse, leading astray and being led astray.

And you -- be remaining in the things which you did learn and were entrusted
confident, convinced with, having known from whom you did learn,

every Writing God-breathed, and profitable for teaching, for conviction, for setting aright
correction , for instruction that in righteousness,

that the man
person of God may be fitted
equipped -- for every good work having been completed.
